title: Arancini
desc: Golden rice balls with a heart full of flavor
incredients: cooked risotto rice, mozzarella cheese, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour, salt, pepper, and oil for frying.
recipe: First, shape cooled risotto around small cubes of mozzarella to form balls. Next, coat them in flour, dip in beaten egg, and roll in breadcrumbs. Then deep-fry until golden and crispy. Drain excess oil and serve hot.

title: Panzerotti
incredients: pizza dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, and optional fillings like basil or mushrooms.
recipe: Roll the dough into small circles, add tomato sauce and mozzarella, then fold and seal the edges. Fry or bake until puffed and golden. Serve warm.

title: Focaccia Bites
desc: Soft, herby, and baked to perfection
incredients: focaccia dough, olive oil, rosemary, garlic, and sea salt.
recipe: Cut focaccia dough into small pieces, brush with olive oil, and sprinkle rosemary and salt. Bake until crisp outside and soft inside. Serve as bite-sized snacks.

title: Supplì
incredients: risotto rice, tomato sauce, mozzarella, eggs, breadcrumbs, and oil for frying.
recipe: Mix risotto with tomato sauce, shape around mozzarella, coat with egg and breadcrumbs, then deep-fry until crisp. Serve hot with a molten cheese center.

title: Italian Sausage Roll
desc: Bold spices wrapped in flaky goodness
incredients: Italian sausage meat, puff pastry, garlic, herbs, egg wash, and seasoning.
recipe: Roll sausage meat in puff pastry, seal the edges, brush with egg wash, and bake until golden brown. Slice and serve warm.

title: Polenta Fries
incredients: polenta, water or stock, butter, salt, pepper, and olive oil.
recipe: Cook polenta until thick, spread in a tray, and let it set. Cut into fries, brush with oil, and bake or fry until crispy. Serve hot.

title: Calzone Pockets
desc: Folded, filled, and full of joy
incredients: pizza dough, ricotta or mozzarella, tomato sauce, olive oil, and herbs.
recipe: Fill rolled dough with cheese and sauce, fold and seal. Bake until golden and puffed. Serve warm.

title: Bruschetta Cups
desc: Fresh toppings in every crunchy bite
incredients: bread slices, tomatoes, garlic, basil, olive oil, and salt.
recipe: Press bread into muffin tins and bake until crisp. Fill with chopped tomatoes mixed with garlic, basil, and olive oil. Serve immediately.

title: Mozzarella in Carrozza
incredients: bread slices, mozzarella cheese, eggs, milk, breadcrumbs, and oil for frying.
recipe: Sandwich mozzarella between bread slices, dip in egg and milk, coat with breadcrumbs, and fry until golden. Serve hot and crispy.

title: Ricotta Spinach Puffs
incredients: ricotta cheese, cooked spinach, puff pastry, garlic, egg wash, and seasoning.
recipe: Mix ricotta and spinach, fill pastry squares, seal, brush with egg wash, and bake until puffed and golden. Serve warm.

title: Piadina Wrap
incredients: flatbread, cheese, grilled vegetables or meats, olive oil, and herbs.
recipe: Warm the flatbread, add fillings, fold or roll, and lightly toast. Serve hot.

title: Gnocchi Fritti
incredients: flour, water, yeast, salt, and oil for frying.
recipe: Prepare soft dough, cut into small pieces, and deep-fry until puffed and golden. Serve hot.

title: Olive Ascolane
desc: Stuffed olives with a crispy twist
incredients: green olives, minced meat, breadcrumbs, eggs, flour, and oil.
recipe: Stuff olives with seasoned meat, coat with flour, egg, and breadcrumbs, then deep-fry until crisp. Serve hot.

title: Zucchini Fritti
desc: Fresh veggies, fried the Italian way
incredients: zucchini slices, flour, salt, and oil for frying.
recipe: Coat zucchini slices lightly in flour, fry until golden and crisp, drain excess oil, and serve hot.

title: Porchetta Sliders
desc: Slow-roasted flavor in every mini bite
incredients: slider buns, roasted pork with herbs, garlic, olive oil, and seasoning.
recipe: Slice roasted porchetta, place into buns, warm slightly, and serve as mini sandwiches.
